decisions.reason: The air quality sensor remains an open option with uncertain but promising prospects and low keeping costs, so the firm maintains it.
As a replacement for an established product, its value is more certain and keeping costs are low, so the option is retained.
The CAN bus module is less prominent but still an option with unresolved uncertainty and moderate keeping costs, so it is held for now.
The CO2 sensor has a dedicated page and likely rising demand, so its option value remains high and the drop probability is low.
